title: REQ · Current round is routed at GET /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current
summary: Route the current round at the specified singular path
description: Context: server.go registers wh.CurrentRound at /rounds/current. Desired behavior: register it at /round/current and drop the plural path. Expected result: the specified path serves the current round JSON. Why: it matches the API contract.
acceptance_criteria: Given seeded world and round files, when GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/round/current is requested, then status is 200 and the JSON round id is round-0000001
When GET /api/v1/worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/current is requested, then status is 404
When GET /api/v1/worlds/unknown/round/current is requested, then status is 404
definition_of_done: Only the singular path is registered for the current round
